title: quality.v1
description: A repository's test-quality floors (00_UniversalStandards/14_Test_Quality.md), committed as .ci/quality.v1.json and read by the central gates. The coverage floor blocks a pull request whose total line coverage falls below it; changed-line coverage is measured and reported on every pull request against changed_lines_target. The mutation floor is held by the nightly mutation run. A floor is raised freely and lowered only through a reviewed pull request named in approved_in; .ci/ is code-owned. A missing or invalid file fails the gate closed.

repo.description: The repository this file belongs to; the gate refuses a file naming another repository.

approved_in.description: The pull request that set the current floors.

floor.description: Total line coverage below this blocks. Set at or just under the measured value, never below 0.6.

changed_lines_target.description: Reported on every pull request; lines below it are listed as untested (features.v1 structure.untested).

path.description: Where the test command writes its report, relative to the repository root.

floor.description: Killed mutants over all mutants, held by the nightly run.

paths.description: The critical paths mutated (authorization, money, data deletion first).
